description: The line plot illustrates the change in loss over iterations for six different models: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis, labeled '#Iteration', ranges from 0 to 140,000 with major tick marks at intervals of 20,000, and the y-axis, labeled 'Loss', spans from 2.4 to 3.4 with major tick marks at intervals of 0.1. All models begin at a high loss value near 3.35 at iteration 0. The Vanilla model (purple line) shows the steepest initial decline, decreasing rapidly to stabilize around 2.45 by iteration 140,000. StrmLLM (n=64) (blue line) declines more slowly, plateauing at approximately 2.7. SepLLM (n=64) (orange line) and SepLLM (n=64, H) (green line) follow similar trajectories, with SepLLM (n=64, H) consistently maintaining a slightly lower loss than SepLLM (n=64), both stabilizing around 2.5. SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red line) achieves the lowest final loss, converging to approximately 2.4. SepLLM (n=128) (dark blue line) stabilizes at a slightly higher loss of about 2.5. A light green vertical line at iteration 0 serves as a reference point. Overall, the SepLLM variants demonstrate superior performance compared to Vanilla and StrmLLM, with SepLLM (n=64, H/T) achieving the best results.
